stories.title: 'I don't know who No. 3 is, but holy s---': Every NFL team's biggest training camp riser of all time
stories.summary: Let's look back to when 32 NFL players kick-started their careers with strong performances in training camp and the preseason -- one from each team.

stories.title: NY sues Kalshi alleging 'illegal gambling'
stories.summary: The state of New York filed a lawsuit against Kalshi on Friday, accusing the prediction market company of running an "illegal gambling operation."

stories.title: Romo placed on leave by CBS after OWI arrest
stories.summary: CBS Sports has placed NFL analyst Tony Romo on leave following his arrest last week on suspicion of driving under the influence.

stories.title: Attorneys clash over text meaning in Rozier case
stories.summary: Terry Rozier's attorney argued in a court filing Friday that a text sent by a co-defendant shows the NBA veteran did not know about the alleged gambling scheme for which he has been indicted.

stories.title: Over 100 women's hoops players join union push
stories.summary: More than 100 women's college basketball players have joined a unionization campaign with the United College Athletes Association, the organization announced.
